evals.prompt: The agency Lead has approved a two-second 1080p60 brand panel with exact copy and local logo/palette, but native versus Remotion is open. Preserve an existing project's source. Prepare the decision and, if Remotion is selected, its editable production handoff. No dependency setup, external footage or paid provider is authorized. Explain how an internal evaluation differs from commercial delivery eligibility.
evals.expected_output: Relays renderer, include/defer/decline and missing human questions through Chris; persists the chosen route once; asks agent-only versus optional hands-on Studio only if Remotion is chosen; plans 120 frames with half-open scene bounds; identifies official Skills through a compatible existing plugin or reviewed upstream route, respects the explicit no-setup restriction and obtains official Skills directly from upstream without redistributing them; preserves source; separates scoped setup and external generation; requires truthful purpose-specific licensing, shared preferences/timeline, frame-driven React/readiness, matching Sound/captions and actual export evidence. Does not claim entitlement or creative approval from allowed=true.
evals.comparison: Run the same prompt/context with and without this Skill on identical disposable baselines. Hold model/settings/tools constant; retain raw responses, source changes and evidence. Compare concrete decisions and deliverables; this fixture has not been run.

evals.prompt: A customized Remotion project has approved a timing revision from 60 to 90 frames and a new Sound master. It retains custom JSX, theme, scene copy, package-lock and previous outputs. The old snapshot is stale, the owner supplied no production eligibility facts, and actual metadata still says 60 frames. Propose the safe revision/export path without reinstalling, weakening gates or inventing a human review. Also explain why a requested yuv420p setting and 1.515-second AAC container are not complete delivery proof.
evals.expected_output: Preserves custom source/dependencies/artifacts; obtains matching canonical timeline/preferences/audio/captions and truthful purpose-specific license record; uses exact refresh --approved-revision acknowledgment with history/hash-named audio; reviews stable/new scene copy and fixes actual composition metadata before a new output directory render. Keeps strict stale/audio/pin checks, distinguishes caller acknowledgment from approval, probes actual range/count/duration/AAC tail, and marks full playback/listening/entitlement unverified.
evals.comparison: Run with-Skill and without-Skill conditions on separate equal project copies with the same tools and supplied records. Retain diffs, commands/exits, artifact hashes and unresolved questions; do not launch a host/provider or new actual render merely because this prompt exists.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this static meeting reminder as one clear sentence: Please share the agenda before Tuesday so everyone can prepare. Preserve its meaning; no video, animation, audio or project setup is requested.
evals.expected_output: Returns only the concise sentence rewrite without invoking Remotion, asking renderer or licence questions, creating media contracts, installing dependencies or routing an ordinary writing task into agency production.

evals.prompt: The Remotion route is already approved and the pinned project has passed preflight and scaffold. The user says: 'I want to tweak the timing and copy myself in the browser.' Record the collaboration choice, the optional official skills pack and the exact safe Studio command, and say what still has to happen before delivery.
evals.expected_output: Records the lead's optional hands-on choice explicitly; reuses scoped setup and eligibility already supplied, verifies discovered official Skill invocation, avoids duplicate installation and obtains official Skills directly from upstream without redistributing them; starts the pinned project-local Studio with the explicit index.jsx entrypoint (npm run studio -- --no-open); treats user edits as source changes; reproofs them; keeps the canonical timeline/fingerprint and Sound handoff; and still delivers through the helper render plus encoded/audiovisual review. Does not install a second Remotion version, expose Studio publicly, or let Studio replace the final measured export.

evals.prompt: Use Remotion for this accepted film. Install its required project-local dependencies and official Skills; decide which Remotion Elements fit the approved character-reaction loop. Existing evaluation eligibility is supplied, no paid service or global setup. There is no renderer package yet. Complete readiness and delegate production, rather than asking me to choose components or install them myself.
evals.expected_output: Chris names one setup owner and delegates Motion. Checks current four-package registry versions, uses latest supported exact release and matching licence record, preserves source, installs scoped dependencies and required official Skills with source/version evidence. Uses actual discovery and successful Skill invocation, not file presence. Director shortlists Elements, records include/adapt/skip rationale (none is valid), checks selected source/dependencies/assets and provenance. No blanket catalog install, redistribution of official Skills, extra setup confirmation, renderer switch or invented entitlement. Produces setup record and applies existing proof/timeline/export gates.
evals.comparison: Prepared-not-run. Maintainer uses a disposable project; inspect actual install, Skill-tool results, delegation and source diffs. No agent launches this live test.

evals.prompt: Revise only the final pose of our approved Remotion 4.0.539 film. Preserve its lockfile and use no installs. The registry now lists 4.0.540 and a Skill is on disk but not discoverable. A helper reported a threshold crossing within one frame.
evals.expected_output: Chris delegates the nontrivial visual revision to Motion and preserves the locked 4.0.539 runtime. Does not upgrade or install against the explicit restriction. Resolves actual Skill discovery/usage or reports the specific limitation; never claims a shell read was a Skill invocation. Reproofs changed source and uses matching canonical timing/audio; does not call threshold crossing audible onset or human sync acceptance.
